GOTCHA RECORDED FOR FUTURE TAGS:
`git tag <name>` (no -a) creates a lightweight tag. `git push --follow-tags` only auto-pushes ANNOTATED tags, so lightweight tags don't ride along with `git push origin main --follow-tags`. Push the tag explicitly: `git push origin <tag>`. This bit us once today on v1.0.0-beta.0; the prep commit went up alone, then we explicitly pushed the tag separately. The codex command commands.release uses `git tag "v$VERSION"` (lightweight, intentional convention here) — pair it with explicit `git push origin "v$VERSION"`.
